title: Ghareeb imam alvida
body:
haye hussain alwida haye hussain alwida
maula hussain alwida aaqa hussain alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
ghareeb imam alwida shaheed imam alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ranj o gham ki barishein ye khoon mein doobi aasteen
ye beshumar zakhm aur tumhara jism e nazneen
hai kaun jo samajh sake tumhare gham ki inteha
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
na waqte zibha zaalimon ne aab boondh bhar diya
rula rula ke tujhko dushmano ne qatl kar diya
tadap rahe hai mustafa bilak rahi hai fatema
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan aza ki wus'atein kahan ye ashke mukhtasir
isi ka shaahe behrobar qalaq rahega saal bhar
tumhare gham mein rone ka hua na hum se haq ada
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
hamara ghut raha hai dum hamay rula rahe hai kyun
abhi to aap aaye thay abhi ye ja rahe hai kyun
hamay batate jaaiye hui hai hum se kya khata
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
na aap aise jaaiye na is tarha rulaiye
jo ja rahe hai aap to ghulamon ko bataiye
ye saal bhar ka faasla ghatega kis tarha bhala
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap rahi hai aurtein bilag rahi hai bacchiyan
sawaal kar rahi hai hum se hind ki udasiyan
thi jis ke dum se raunaqein wo ab kahan chala gaya
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahan ye gham ki barishein kahan aza ki raunaqein
kahan naseeb hongi saal bhar wafa ki raunaqein
alam jo hum badhayenge lagega ghar luta luta
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
khata jo hogayi ho kuch tu usko bakhsh dijiye
gunah gaar hai bohat humay muaaf kijiye
qasam hai aap ko janabe hurr ki shaahe karbala
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo hoga beqarar dil to farshe gham bichayenge
mere imam aap ko hum apne ghar bulayenge
zaroor aaiyega aap ko azaa ka waasta
ghareeb imam alwida...
<<DIVIDER>>
kareem ho karam karo qasam hai tumko shaahe deen
bilal e kazmi tumhara ho ke aamir e hazeen
ye dono beqarar hai bula lo jald karbala
ghareeb imam alwida...
author: Bilal Kazmi
